say:1:1524644001:0.text: While you were away, tensions between the Halians and us eased considerably. We've been trading and sharing knowledge way more than before.
say:1:1524644001:0.source_cn: 您不在的这段时间，雅库伯尔与呼临的关系缓和了不少，彼此...
say:1:1524644001:0.male: While you were away, tensions between the Halians and us eased considerably. We've been trading and sharing knowledge way more than before.
say:1:1524644001:0.female: While you were away, tensions between the Halians and us eased considerably. We've been trading and sharing knowledge way more than before.

say:2:1524644002:1.text: Recently, some of our folks have taken up animal husbandry from the Halians, learning to raise sheep.
say:2:1524644002:1.source_cn: 最近有族人开始向呼临人学习畜牧，圈了块地养了一些羊。
say:2:1524644002:1.male: Recently, some of our folks have taken up animal husbandry from the Halians, learning to raise sheep.
say:2:1524644002:1.female: Recently, some of our folks have taken up animal husbandry from the Halians, learning to raise sheep.

say:3:1524644003:1.text: I don't know the first thing about livestock. Could you check on their progress for me?
say:3:1524644003:1.source_cn: 我对这方面不大了解，能否请您替我去看看他们进展如何？
say:3:1524644003:1.male: I don't know the first thing about livestock. Could you check on their progress for me?
say:3:1524644003:1.female: I don't know the first thing about livestock. Could you check on their progress for me?
